permits.summary: Kenyan national building law and Nairobi County development-control starting points for a new build, alteration or change of use.

items.title: Development permission / land-use review
items.when: Likely applicable to building work or a material change of use; the exact county process and supporting documents depend on the site and proposal.
items.source: Kenya Law — Physical and Land Use Planning Act

items.title: Building-plan and code review
items.when: Likely applicable before construction. The National Building Code, 2024 commenced on 20 February 2025; verify the current Nairobi submission route and project classification.
items.authority: Nairobi City County and relevant registered professionals

items.title: Construction project registration
items.when: Likely applicable after a construction contract is awarded; the NCA states that developers register projects and lists the current supporting approvals.

items.title: Completion and occupation clearance
items.when: Likely applicable before opening a completed or altered building; confirm inspection, accessibility, fire and occupation requirements for the approved plans.
items.authority: Nairobi City County and relevant safety authorities
items.source: Nairobi Planning and Development Management System

permits.summary: Ugandan building-control law and local Building Committee starting points for a mosque project in Kampala.

items.title: Planning and land-use review
items.when: Likely applicable before a building application, particularly where the proposal changes land use; confirm the site-specific pathway with KCCA.
items.authority: Kampala Capital City Authority and local physical planning professionals
items.source: NBRB — What you need to know about building permits

items.title: Building permit application
items.when: Likely applicable before building operations. Submission requirements depend on the class and scope and may include registered architect and engineer documentation.

items.title: Current building-control law review
items.when: Likely applicable throughout design and construction. Uganda amended the Building Control Act in 2026, so verify how the amendment affects the project before relying on earlier guidance.
items.authority: National Building Review Board and KCCA Building Committee

items.title: Occupation permit
items.when: Likely applicable before occupation after practical completion; the Building Committee examines conformity with approved plans and regulations.

permits.summary: Planning, building regulations and operational fire-safety pathways for public worship premises.

items.title: Planning permission / change of use
items.when: Likely applicable where the proposal changes use or includes development; public worship is listed under use class F1(f).

items.title: Building regulations approval
items.when: Likely applicable to new building work and many material alterations or changes of use.

items.title: Fire risk assessment and precautions
items.when: Likely applicable while operating a place of assembly; duties depend on premises and management.
items.source: GOV.UK — Fire safety risk assessment for assembly premises

permits.summary: City-specific zoning, construction and place-of-assembly pathways for houses of worship.

items.title: Zoning and building filing
items.when: Likely applicable to a new building, alteration or change in lawful use.

items.title: Place of Assembly Certificate of Operation
items.when: NYC states this is required at specified indoor/outdoor gathering thresholds; verify current occupancy and scope.
items.source: NYC Buildings — Place of Assembly Certificate of Operation

items.title: Annual fire inspection / permit pathway
items.when: Likely applicable after a PACO is issued; confirm current FDNY requirements.
items.source: NYC Buildings — Place of Assembly Certificate of Operation

permits.summary: Development-consent pathway for a new or adapted place of public worship, subject to local planning controls.

items.title: Development application
items.when: The NSW guidance identifies new builds, alterations and conversion/adaptation as proposals requiring a development application.
items.source: NSW Planning — places of public worship guidance

items.title: Local environmental and development-control review
items.when: Likely applicable through the development assessment against local and state planning controls.
items.source: NSW Planning — places of public worship guidance

funding.summary: Kenyan charitable-organization and donation rules require entity-specific tax, governance and fundraising review.

items.title: Charitable-purpose and exemption review
items.when: Potentially relevant before making tax-exempt or donor-deductibility representations; the 2024 rules include advancement of religion and places of worship but eligibility and approval must be verified.
items.authority: Kenya Revenue Authority and qualified Kenyan tax counsel
items.source: KRA — Charitable Organisations and Donations Exemption Rules, 2024

items.title: Restricted project campaign controls
items.when: Document the campaign purpose, authorisation, signatories, records, reporting cadence and treatment of surplus before accepting funds.
items.authority: Organization trustees and qualified Kenyan advisers
items.source: KRA — Charitable Organisations and Donations Exemption Rules, 2024

items.title: Waqf or endowment structure
items.when: Specialist Kenyan legal, tax, governance and qualified Shariah review is required before representing land, money or another asset as waqf.
items.authority: Trustees, Kenyan counsel and qualified Shariah reviewers

funding.summary: Uganda Revenue Authority guidance distinguishes direct religious receipts from taxable income-generating activities and requires an exemption letter for qualifying institutions.

items.title: Religious-institution exemption review
items.when: Potentially relevant before making exemption claims; URA says a letter of exemption from the Commissioner General is required and private benefit is restricted.
items.authority: Uganda Revenue Authority and qualified Ugandan tax counsel

items.title: Campaign records and tax obligations
items.when: Document donations and fundraising separately from business, rental, employment, import or other activities that may carry distinct registration, return or tax obligations.
items.authority: Uganda Revenue Authority, trustees and qualified advisers

items.title: Waqf or endowment structure
items.when: Specialist Ugandan legal, tax, governance and qualified Shariah review is required before representing land, money or another asset as waqf.
items.authority: Trustees, Ugandan counsel and qualified Shariah reviewers

funding.summary: Charity funds, restricted purposes and permanent endowment are governed through the charity’s documents and Charity Commission framework.

items.title: General or restricted fundraising campaign
items.when: Trustees should document purpose, controls, reporting and how funds further the charity’s objects.
items.source: Charity Commission — managing money, assets and property

items.title: Permanent-endowment assessment
items.when: Potentially relevant where donated assets must be retained rather than spent; governing documents determine treatment.

funding.summary: Federal tax-exempt and contribution rules are only one layer; state charity, fundraising and property rules still require review.

items.title: Religious-organization tax status review
items.when: Potentially relevant to entity setup and donor representations; verify recognition and state requirements.

items.title: Contribution substantiation workflow
items.when: Likely relevant when acknowledging donations or representing deductibility.

items.title: Endowment or reserve policy
items.when: Board, legal, investment and qualified Shariah review required; do not assume a generic endowment is a waqf.

funding.summary: ACNC charity obligations combine with state or territory fundraising regulation.

items.title: Charity registration and subtype review
items.when: Potentially relevant before making charity-status representations.

items.title: Fundraising-law review
items.when: Likely applicable in each state or territory where funds are raised.
items.source: ACNC — charity fundraising and the public

items.title: Basic Religious Charity assessment
items.when: Only relevant where all ACNC criteria are met; do not assume the category applies.
